name: Squire
source:
The squire is probably the laziest and most carefree person in Caerulia. But with only four months left before a deadly war happens, the Squire will stop at nothing to find the girl of his dreams and experience man's greatest pleasure.

Likes: Knights, Drinking, Girls, Cows

Dislikes: Chores, Magic
